title: RELAXED ZIP HOODIE
description:
• Zip-front hoodie in a heavyweight 535gsm cotton blend fleece
  • Relaxed, slightly cropped fit with a raglan sleeve, brushed interior and Stüssy authentic workgear label at the side seam
  • YKK metal zip closure
  • Round woven drawcord in hood
  • Patch pockets
  • Slim rib at cuffs and hem
  • Unisex
  • Material: 66% cotton / 34% polyester
  • Imported
